events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, featuring legendary performances.

angles.name: Woodstock's Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years ago, a field in upstate New York became the epicentre of a cultural revolution. The Woodstock Festival began, defining a generation with peace, love, and three days of incredible music. Which legendary performance still resonates with you?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the world mourned the death of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: 49 years ago, we lost the King of Rock and Roll. Elvis Presley's music and charisma continue to captivate millions. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Impact
angles.copy: On this day in 1996, the music world lost a true icon. Tupac Shakur's powerful lyrics and undeniable presence left an indelible mark on hip-hop and beyond. His legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix's Genius
angles.copy: 56 years ago, we said goodbye to a true guitar pioneer. Jimi Hendrix redefined what was possible with six strings. His sound remains as electrifying today as it ever was.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road's Iconic Sound
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic zebra crossing, those unforgettable tracks... it's an album that still sounds as fresh today. What's your favourite from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman continues to rock with that unmistakable voice and attitude.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Wishing the one and only Liam Gallagher a very happy birthday. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message of Peace
angles.copy: 55 years ago, John Lennon released his timeless album 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as powerfully today. A true masterpiece.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: 25 years ago, Apple dropped the original iPod, changing how we listened to music forever. Hands up if you remember painstakingly syncing your entire CD collection to one of these!

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' first hit screens. Who's your favourite 007 and what's the best Bond theme tune? Licence to thrill indeed.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the birthday of the legendary Beatles co-founder, John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incomparable John Lennon. A musical visionary and a voice for peace. His legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his unique brand of comedy is truly timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The Eclectic White Album
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. Its sprawling, experimental sound proved they were still pushing boundaries. So many classics on one record!

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the music world lost legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost one of the greatest showmen and voices in music history, Freddie Mercury. His incredible talent and stage presence are truly missed.
